about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Wave Form.about: VST3 parameter 0. Host display: 0 = Triangle; 1 = Sawtooth; 2 = Square; 2 = Square; 3 = Noise.

parameters/Pitch.about: VST3 parameter 1. Host display: -12 = -12.000 notes; -6 = -6.000 notes; 0 = 0.000 notes; 6 = 6.000 notes; 12 = 12.000 notes.

parameters/Pulse Width Mod.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = None; 1 = MG; 2 = EG; 2 = EG; 3 = EG (Inv).

parameters/Attack.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 900.0 ms; 0.5 = 2.880 sec; 0.75 = 8.955 sec; 1 = 18.00 sec.

parameters/Decay.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 1.050 sec; 0.5 = 3.360 sec; 0.75 = 10.45 sec; 1 = 21.00 sec.

parameters/Sustain.about: VST3 parameter 9. Host display: 0 = -INF dB; 0.25 = -12.04 dB; 0.5 = -6.02 dB; 0.75 = -2.50 dB; 1 = 0.00 dB.

parameters/Release.about: VST3 parameter 10. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 1.150 sec; 0.5 = 3.680 sec; 0.75 = 11.44 sec; 1 = 23.00 sec.

parameters/Hold.about: VST3 parameter 11. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 950.0 ms; 0.5 = 3.040 sec; 0.75 = 9.453 sec; 1 = 19.00 sec.

parameters/MG Type.about: VST3 parameter 13. Host display: 0 = Triangle; 0 = Triangle; 1 = Square; 1 = Square; 1 = Square.

parameters/Oscillator EG Type.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: 0 = Normal; 0 = Normal; 1 = Inverted; 1 = Inverted; 1 = Inverted.

parameters/Filter EG Type.about: VST3 parameter 20. Host display: 0 = Normal; 0 = Normal; 1 = Inverted; 1 = Inverted; 1 = Inverted.

parameters/Noise.about: VST3 parameter 22. Host display: 0 = -INF dB; 0.25 = -26.02 dB; 0.5 = -15.92 dB; 0.75 = -6.06 dB; 1 = 0.00 dB.

parameters/NoiseType.about: VST3 parameter 23. Host display: 0 = White; 0 = White; 1 = Pink; 1 = Pink; 1 = Pink.

parameters/Volume.about: VST3 parameter 24. Host display: 0 = -INF dB; 0.25 = -19.80 dB; 0.5 = -10.80 dB; 0.75 = -1.80 dB; 1 = +7.20 dB.

parameters/Polyphony.about: VST3 parameter 27. Host display: 0 = Mono; 0 = Mono; 1 = Poly; 1 = Poly; 1 = Poly.

parameters/Sync Mode.about: VST3 parameter 28. Host display: 0 = Free; 0 = Free; 1 = Synched; 1 = Synched; 1 = Synched.

parameters/Sync Type.about: VST3 parameter 29. Host display: 0 = 16 bars; 3 = 2 bars; 5 = 1/2 bar; 8 = 1/16 bar; 10 = 1/64 bar.
